instruction: In the mouse and touchpad settings, enable natural scrolling.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
import pyautogui; pyautogui.hotkey('alt', 'F4'); import time; time.sleep(0.3);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling natural scrolling for mouse via mouse/touchpad settings. Initial config sets natural-scroll to false. Agent must navigate settings and enable it. Evaluator verifies natural-scroll is true.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correct: vm_command_line executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.peripherals.mouse natural-scroll' and returns the setting state
Expected value semantically correct: 'true\n' matches gsettings output format including newline character
Metric parameter handling correct: exact_match receives rules dict (from get_rule) and accesses rules['expected'] directly - no incorrect nested access like rules.get('rules')
Complete coverage: instruction requires enabling natural scrolling, evaluator verifies natural-scroll setting equals true
State accessibility reliable: command-line verification via gsettings doesn't depend on UI state, works after postconfig closes settings window
Logical flow sound: initial config sets to false, agent enables via UI, evaluator confirms via gsettings command
